name: Judas
description: Apostle living at the time of the New Testament

points: The twelve are named here, ending with Judas Iscariot, who also betrayed him.

note.label: Matthew 10: The Twelve Sent to the Lost Sheep

points: Then one of the twelve, called Judas Iscariot, went unto the chief priests, and said unto them, What will ye give me, and I will deliver him unto you? Imagine that: somebody around you willing to give you up, lie, steal, and cheat for money. We had a whole Israelite camp back in the day break up because of money.
Then entered Satan into Judas surnamed Iscariot, being of the number of the twelve.

note.label: Luke 22: The Passover, the Betrayal, and the Denial

points: Judas, betrayest thou the Son of man with a kiss?

note.label: Luke 22: The Passover, the Betrayal, and the Denial

points: “And Judas also, which betrayed him, knew the place”. We have to be mindful. Judas knew their secret hideout, where they used to go with the disciples.

note.label: When Good Intentions Lead To Bad Judgement In Israel

cases.name: Judas Iscariot
cases.charge: Theft from the common purse; betraying innocent blood for thirty pieces of silver
cases.preview: One of the twelve, he carried the bag and took what was put in it, and his objection to the ointment at Bethany was made in the name of the poor although he cared nothing for them (John 12:4-6).
